propositions: 108 store tickets carry Success Criteria bullets that are invisible to acceptance criteria counting and cannot be individually checked as completion verifiers require checkboxes.

Migrating Success Criteria bullets to Acceptance Criteria checkboxes must be done via rebar.edit_ticket script to create auditable events, with dry-run as default and explicit flag required to modify non-closed tickets.

Order-sensitive rewrite logic corrupted 97 of 104 tickets in initial implementation by duplicating AC blocks and headings when SC preceded AC; fix required order-agnostic _splice helper and idempotency validation.

Live migration of 106 total tickets (104 initial pass + 2 stragglers) completed with qualified heading variants (parenthetical suffixes) initially missed; pattern-based prefix matching resolved the issue.

Post-migration verification confirms zero Success Criteria headings remain, zero tickets below AC floor, 27/27 test cases green, and complete rollback capability via captured pre-run state and rebar revert.
